newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Arafat briefs Tunisian President on peace process.
newsitem.headline: Arafat briefs Tunisian President on peace process.

text.p: Palestinian President Yasser Arafat arrived in Tunis on Monday and briefed Tunisian President Zine al-Abidine Ben Ali on the Middle East peace process.
"I have briefed the President over the last developments of the difficult negotiations with the Israeli government which were concluded by the Hebron deal," Arafat said after the meeting.
"I regret that the accord's implementation has been frozen since it was signed," he added.

Arafat met Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu at Davos in Switzerland on Sunday and is due to meet him again on Thursday to discuss implementation of outstanding points from the Hebron agreement signed last month.
